description: Frontend: surface the prediction's metrics-used basis in the PredictionPanel so the win-pct basis is explainable (GitHub Issue #15 acceptance criterion 3). Consume the new additive Prediction.metrics field, render each team's regular-season win pct in the PredictionResult block, add localized EN/JA i18n strings, and extend the Playwright e2e + component tests to assert the win-pct basis is shown. Depends on FEAT-001 (requires the shared Prediction.metrics type and the backend response field).
steps: In frontend/src/i18n/messages.ts, add a new `prediction.metrics.*` key family to the MessageKey union and to BOTH the en and ja maps, consistent with the existing prediction.* entries. Suggested keys: 'prediction.metrics.title' (EN 'Prediction basis' / JA '予測の根拠'), 'prediction.metrics.winPct' (EN 'Regular-season win %' / JA 'レギュラーシーズン勝率'), 'prediction.metrics.unknown' (EN 'Not available' / JA 'データなし'), and a per-team line template 'prediction.metrics.team' (EN '{team}: {pct}' / JA '{team}: {pct}'). Keep wording concise and parallel to existing strings; do NOT use em dashes.

In frontend/src/components/PredictionPanel.tsx, update the PredictionResult component to read `prediction.metrics` (optional). When present, render a small, accessible 'Prediction basis' block (e.g. a <div className="prediction__metrics"> with a heading using prediction.metrics.title and two lines for favorite and underdog) showing each team's win pct formatted as a percentage (e.g. (winPct*100).toFixed(1) + '%') via teamName(t, teamId) for the label; when a team's winPct is null, show t('prediction.metrics.unknown'). Guard the whole block behind `prediction.metrics` being defined so older/absent responses render unchanged. Reuse existing className conventions; add minimal styles to frontend/src/styles.css only if needed for layout (follow existing prediction__* class patterns).

Update frontend/src/components/PredictionPanel.test.tsx: extend the mocked prediction response used by the success-path test(s) to include a `metrics` object and assert the panel renders the win-pct basis (heading text and the formatted percentages for favorite and underdog), and assert that a null winPct renders the localized 'unknown' text. Keep existing assertions intact. If the test mocks the api getPrediction, update that mock's return shape to carry metrics.

Update frontend/e2e/prediction.spec.ts (and frontend/e2e/fixtures.ts if the prediction response is fixtured there) so the stubbed /prediction response includes the additive `metrics` field, then add an assertion that the PredictionPanel shows the win-pct basis text (the metrics title and at least one percentage) when a prediction is displayed. Match the existing Playwright route-stubbing / fixture style used by the other e2e specs.
Run the frontend build, unit tests, and the prediction e2e spec to confirm the basis is shown and everything stays green (install chromium first if Playwright reports it is missing).
acceptance_criteria: The PredictionPanel displays the metrics used for the prediction (each team's regular-season win pct) when the response carries `metrics`, localized in both EN and JA (maps to Issue #15 criterion 3).
A null/unknown win pct renders a localized 'not available' string rather than NaN or a blank.
Responses without `metrics` still render the existing prediction UI unchanged (backward compatible).
frontend unit tests assert the win-pct basis is rendered; the Playwright prediction e2e asserts the basis text appears.
PATH=... npm run build -w @mlb/frontend, npm test -w @mlb/frontend, and npm run test:e2e -w @mlb/frontend all pass.
